hook: orphan self- 族進自白亭：self-righteous／self-deprecating／self-defeating——鏡子回嘴「你確定要這樣介紹自己？」
script: self-righteous 自以為義。self-deprecating 自我貶低。self-defeating 自我拆台。self-abasement 自辱。self-assertion 自作主張。口令：鏡子寫「有自知之明」，別只剩自我攻防。

members.senseAnchor: characterized by a certainty, especially an unfounded one,
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 正義鏡: self-righteous walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「正義鏡」出場：self-righteous 一上場梗就黏住——自以為是的。

related.synonyms: holier-than-thou, pietistic, pietistical, pharisaic, pharisaical, sanctimonious

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 貶低鏡: self-deprecating walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「貶低鏡」出場：self-deprecating 一上場梗就黏住——自我貶低的。

members.senseAnchor: causing more problems than it solves
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 拆台鏡: self-defeating walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「拆台鏡」出場：self-defeating 一上場梗就黏住——自我拆台的。

members.senseAnchor: voluntary self-punishment in order to atone for some wrongdoing
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 鞠躬鏡: self-abasement walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「鞠躬鏡」出場：self-abasement 一上場梗就黏住——自辱。

members.senseAnchor: the act of putting forth your own opinions in a boastful or inconsiderate manner that implies you feel superior to others; the act of asserting yourself in an aggressive manner
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 舉手鏡: self-assertion walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「舉手鏡」出場：self-assertion 一上場梗就黏住——自我主張。

members.senseAnchor: a GRE-level vocabulary item meaning closely related to its core sense in academic English
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 光環過頭: self-righteousness walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「光環過頭」出場：self-righteousness 一上場梗就黏住——自以為義。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 大我牌: egotism walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「大我牌」出場：egotism 一上場梗就黏住——自我中心。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 小我牌: modesty walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「小我牌」出場：modesty 一上場梗就黏住——謙遜。

members.senseAnchor: an exceptional interest in and admiration for yourself
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 自拍燈: narcissism walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「自拍燈」出場：narcissism 一上場梗就黏住——自戀。
